text:
maria: FYI I opened an RFC PR for consolidating staged artifact signer rotation into a single operator hook for on‑prem / air‑gapped installs. Looking for quick architecture review on the operator <-> KMS/HSM boundary and failure modes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/412

sam: quick q — does the operator ever hold private key material for rotation? for airgapped sites that would be a hard no.

igor: +1 it should never hold private keys. The RFC suggests a signed delegation token model and an offline signer agent for airgap. Section 3.2 outlines seed-transfer handshake.

lucy: main customer concern: adding rotation steps increases upgrade complexity. Can we offer an automated flow but keep a manual fallback? e.g., auto-accept via HSM PIN or admin-accept via USB-signed manifest.

maria: exactly. Plan is: default automated path for Dedicated/Hosted; for Private/airgap we support two modes: (1) offline-accept where operator uploads rotation manifest and admin signs, (2) hsm-backed auto-accept if customer exposes KMS endpoint.

maria: snippet from RFC manifest example:
```yaml
rotation:
  version: 1
  signer_pub: "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAACAQ..."
  overlap_window_seconds: 3600
  acceptance_mode: offline|hsm
```

deploy-bot: validator: rotation-manifest lint OK (3498765440) :white_check_mark:

sam: another edge-case: what if rotation half-applies (some nodes move to new signer, others remain)? we need a safe rollback or dual-signer overlap. RFC mentions dual-signer overlap but we should be explicit about timelines.

igor: suggest explicit 3-stage state machine:
- STAGE A: old signer only (pre-rotation)
- STAGE B: overlap (both signers accepted, for N seconds)
- STAGE C: new signer only (post-commit)
This makes rollback deterministic: if commit fails in B->C, revert to A within window.

sam: add test: simulate node power-loss during B->C and ensure older images still accepted for at least overlap_window. Also add audit events.

maria: good call. I'll add e2e tests that inject node reboots and network partitions and assert acceptance semantics and rollback. Also adding telemetry events: rotation_started, rotation_overlap_entered, rotation_committed, rotation_rollback.

lucy: please also add a migration shim for older operator versions that don't understand overlap semantics — perhaps accept both old and new signatures for X versions.

maria: will add compatibility layer to RFC and implement a short-lived shim (operators < v2.3) will treat rotation manifests as dual-accept.

igor: one more thought: how do we handle airgap seed transfer verification? include a signed checksum and operator verifies blob integrity before activating. snippet in RFC: 
```text
> verify: sha256sum(manifest.tar.gz)==<expected>
> verify-signature: offline-signer.sig by signer_pub
```

sam: stacking requirements: HSM path should be optional but well-documented. customers often only want a USB-signer route. Add an admin UX doc for the USB-signer flow.

maria: noted — I'll add a small admin-runbook with example commands and rollback steps.

lucy: LGTM overall. just ask that the RFC call out upgrade hooks for older images and provide a no-op path for test clusters.

maria: thanks all — tagging for review @sam @igor. I'll push an updated PR with tests, telemetry, and compat shim by EOD. :thumbsup:
